title: Electronics - Chapter 5: PCB Layout: Setup and Placement

questions.question: Why does Chapter 5 stress Design for Excellence on placement?
options: Layout is performed once while manufacturing may run millions of times.
Placement never affects routing, test, or assembly automation.
DFx only applies to silk-screen fonts and company logos.
Locking parts is optional until after the fab scrap report.
questions.explanation: PCB layout is only performed once, and the manufacturing process

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Tips for Placing Parts: FFConsidering the PCB layout is only performed once, and the manufacturing process dictated by the PCB layout can be performed millions of times, Design for Excellence (including design for Fabrication, Assembly, and Test) must be considered during placement.

questions.question: After mechanically fixed components are located, you should:
options: Leave them unlocked so auto-place can shuffle them overnight.
Lock them into place before moving functional groups.
Delete them from the database to simplify DRC.
Move them only after every signal is fully routed.
questions.explanation: Once fixed components are located, lock them into place

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: FFOnce fixed components are located, lock them into place. FFColor code nets in the layout based on their node count and their criticality.

questions.question: Color-coding nets in the layout is recommended based on:
options: The project manager’s favorite sports team colors only.
Node count and net function to make collaboration easier.
Random hues regenerated every time the file is saved.
Soldermask color availability at the cheapest fab.
questions.explanation: Color code nets in the layout based on their node count

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: FFColor code nets in the layout based on their node count and their criticality.

questions.question: High-Speed guide - components or vias between differential pairs:
options: Are encouraged to shorten the pair length at any cost.
Should not be placed between pairs; they create impedance discontinuity.
Are required by IPC whenever pairs change layers.
Only matter for power nets, never for high-speed pairs.
questions.explanation: components or vias should not be placed between differential pairs

reference.excerpt: When differential pairs change layers and therefore change reference ground planes, ground transition vias are required which connect the two different ground references.

questions.question: Smooth out placement for DFx aiming at:
options: Only maximizing unconnected air wires on purpose.
Better routing, future test points, automated placement, and heat considerations.
Hiding all reference designators under large BGAs forever.
Packing parts so no probe or nozzle can ever reach a pad.

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: FFConsider balancing out the spacing between less-critical parts at this point such as adding spacing between components for better routing, future test points, automated placement, heat profiling, and inspection.

questions.question: True or false: Chapter 5 says group components off-board primarily by their functional relationships before placing groups.

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: FFGroup components together off-board; primarily based upon their functionality with shortest distance between signal and power pins, and secondarily how they are shown in the schematic.

questions.question: SpaceX NPI readiness connects to placement because:
options: Placement density never affects assembly yield or test access.
Supplier process capability must match how parts are grouped and accessed for build/test.
Auto-place defaults guarantee rate production without EMS review.
Only schematic capture quality matters for launch-vehicle electronics.
questions.explanation: Smooth out the placement in consideration for DFx

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Smooth out the placement in consideration for DFx
reference.lecture: Ensure suppliers are prepared to support prototype, ramp, and rate
